evidence.title: Select a currently authorized visible Incident/Task row without changing the canonical Command Work Queue route
evidence.goal: Deliver CAP-CMD-101 Class-0 row selection and limited owner-authorized selected context on the existing Command route. Preserve current view/status/sort, prevent denied or off-page object disclosure and do not create an Inspector, Incident Detail provider, mutation or Saved View.
outputs: Opt-in selected Row JSON field emitted only after fresh ACL and exact current page match; unselected JSON remains backward-compatible.
Accessible same-form row-selection action with selected context containing only already-authorized row fields; current view/filter/sort retained.
No actual Incident Detail or Inspector; no selected persistent state nor linking to Case/Run.
acceptance_tests: Request selecting an authorized visible Task in a filtered oldest-first view gives exactly that Row, while Project calls Owner.List once and CanRead once per in-scope candidate.
Select denied/foreign/wrong view or status/off-page item: generic 404 with no object data; session/owner errors still yield no partial response.
Invalid/duplicate/overlong/UTF-8/control selection fails 400 before session or owner; unsupported client-scope filters still rejected.
HTML selection button remains on one existing GET route, safely escapes malicious IDs, preserves view/filter/sort, and adds no extra system views or new Inspector.
Legacy requests keep original JSON field set; complete Linux/macOS/Windows Go runtime CI and mandatory unchanged security/complexity checks on final SHA.

rules: Strict tenant isolation and permission checking
